title: The dashboard lists the models each host can run, and adds or removes one
name: models-screen
description: `sober models` and `sober models add <name> "<run>" --complexity 1-3` (packages/cli/src/models.ts) are command-line only, and nothing removes a model. Add a read route and a write route over core's models.ts with tests, and a screen that lists per host (`claude`, `codex`, `openrouter`) every model Jev could pick — the list live-list builds from the catalogues, `dispatch.sources` and the pins in `dispatch.models` — with the tier each covers. Every model row has a remove: a catalogue model gets a `deny` entry for its id in that source's `dispatch.sources` block, a pinned entry is deleted from `dispatch.models`. Add works two ways: pick a model from a host's catalogue (lifts a matching `deny`, or pins it when a filter still keeps it out) or type a pin by hand (name, run line, complexity) — e.g. adding `fable` to Claude when it is not in the table. The CLI gains `sober models remove <name>` writing the same change, so the command line and the dashboard never disagree. Writes go through core, never the config file text by hand, and keep the config's comments. Waits on live-list, which defines the list and `dispatch.sources`. Delete the models entry from KNOWN_GAPS.

brief.approach: Move CLI-only addModel write logic from packages/cli/src/models.ts into a shared core model mutation in packages/core/src/models.ts using config.ts applySetting/setSetting so comments survive. Add core operations to remove a model by name: a pinned dispatch.models entry is removed from that array; a catalogue candidate is excluded by appending its exact id to the corresponding dispatch.sources.<host>.deny list. Add a model by catalogue id by lifting an exact deny, or pinning it when only filters still exclude it; typed custom pins accept name, run line and complexity 1–10 with existing validation. Add matching `sober models remove <name>` CLI path. In packages/server/src/routes.ts expose one read returning liveModels plus per-host catalogue/pin/deny state and add/remove write operations, with strict schemas and route tests. In apps/dashboard/src/models/ build a host-grouped screen (claude/codex/openrouter) showing available models, coverage range, add and remove controls, and explicit feedback on pending/errors; wire from App.tsx and remove add_model from dashboard and server GAPS. Update operation schema/contract coverage for remove_model. Reuse existing styling and run only targeted tests.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/models.test.ts packages/cli/src/models.test.ts packages/server/src/routes.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Catalog and pin additions/removals retain config comments and server/CLI use the same behavior.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/integration/contract.test.ts test/integration/cli.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Dashboard operations and CLI add/remove commands satisfy the public contract.

acceptance.run: pnpm build && pnpm exec biome check packages/core/src/models.ts packages/cli/src/models.ts packages/server/src/routes.ts apps/dashboard/src/models apps/dashboard/src/App.tsx test/integration/contract.test.ts
acceptance.proves: The changed model surfaces compile and pass style checks.

plain.what: Show available models by host in the dashboard and let users add or remove them there and in the CLI.
plain.why: Model selection currently needs manual CLI/config work and cannot remove an entry.
plain.check: Run focused core, CLI, server and contract tests plus build and style checks.
plain.risk: A removal can change future dispatch choices; config writes must preserve comments and distinguish catalogue denies from pinned entries.
